title: The Power of the Powerless: The Workers Defense Committee (KOR)

abstracts.content: The Workers’ Defence Committee (KOR) was founded in 1976 in Poland. Its primal objective was to help people persecuted by the state. A year later it was transformed into the Committee for the Social Self-Defence ‘KOR’, which took up the continuous struggle for civil rights. Several hundred activists of the dissent movement created a parallel world in which the germs of civic society emerged – uncensored press and publishing houses, independent groups of students and farmers, the Flying University and free trade unions. Thus, KOR’s founders created the new model of opposition in the communist system: acting openly in the framework of the law, founded on human and civil rights, non-violent, focused on reconstructing social ties and social consciousness, inciting social activity. This evolutionary strategy set the direction of democratic transition in Poland.

title: Pro-Russian Organizations in Poland after 1986 Agents of Chaos

abstracts.content: This book shows how, for 35 years, Russia has been supporting its agents of influence and allies in a seemingly highly hostile society – Poland. Conspiracy narratives, ideological harmony, and old alliances from the period of the Eastern Bloc are primarily the glue that binds the Russian network of influence. In-depth journalistic investigations, spy trials, and embarrassing email leaks – here, you can find many answers to how Moscow works when it wants to influence the political situation in third countries, in this case, Poland. The Polish case study of the “pro-Russian camp” shows how the Kremlin operates in NATO’s eastern flank, wanting to increase political polarization, supporting radicalism, and strengthening the message of extremists, from both the right and the left. This book tells us what political circles Moscow’s Polish allies come from, their goals, and their beliefs. It also shows their international alliances, outlining the Russian network of influence in the European Union and more broadly. The author also tries to impose on this set of political entities a network of concepts, doctrines, and theories the Moscow center uses to show permanent mechanisms of action. As a result, this book ceases to be just a case study of Poland and becomes a much more helpful study, allowing the use of patterns obtained from many years of research summarized in this publication to understand Russia’s influence in other regions. Having examined the reasons for cooperation with Russia – ideological, geopolitical, and historical – in a country as reluctant to form alliances as Poland and understanding the mechanisms of selection and influence on such actors by the Kremlin, we can transfer this knowledge to understand the pattern to other countries. It will be of interest to researchers of Russian and Polish politics, right wing nationalism, and hybrid warfare.

title: Ausgleich von Fairness und Fürsorge durch ästhetische Betrachtungen im humanistischen Management in der Gig Economy

abstracts.content: Dieses Kapitel vertieft sich in die Ästhetik, um das Verständnis zu erweitern und das humanistische Management in der Gig-Wirtschaft zu verbessern, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf dem ästhetischen Ansatz liegt, der komplementär zur Ethik ist, und die Schönheit, Harmonie und bedeutungsvollen Erfahrungen von Einzelpersonen (Managern und Mitarbeitern) schätzt. Die Natur der Gig-Wirtschaft untergräbt traditionelle Vorstellungen von Work-Life-Balance und menschenzentrierten Prinzipien, was es entscheidend macht, zu analysieren, wie Ästhetik eine zentrale Rolle bei der Förderung von Gerechtigkeit, Fairness und Fürsorge für Gig-Arbeiter spielen kann. Das Kapitel untersucht: 1) das Zusammenspiel von Ästhetik und Humanismus im Management; 2) die Annahme eines ästhetischen Ansatzes ermöglicht es Unternehmen, über die enge Verfolgung von wirtschaftlichem Gewinn hinauszugehen; 3) praktische Integration von Ästhetik in die Perspektiven der Gig-Arbeiter und die Managementpraktiken von Gig-Plattformen; 4) Virtuosität, Künstlertum und Kreativität können das Erlebnis der Gig-Arbeiter transformieren. Die Bedeutung der Ästhetik bei der Gestaltung der Wahrnehmungen von Managern, Arbeitern und Verbrauchern von Gig-Dienstleistungen betont, dass ästhetisch wahrgenommene Erfahrungen zu einem Gefühl von Fürsorge und sozialer Verantwortung in den Angeboten der Gig-Plattformen beitragen. Diese Verschiebung hin zu einem stärker ästhetischen Ansatz kann das Vertrauen zwischen Gig-Arbeitern, Plattformen und Verbrauchern stärken, gegenseitigen Respekt fördern und Interaktionen vertiefen.

title: Rywalizacja USA–Chiny w Azji Południowej w świetle neorealizmu ofensywnego

abstracts.content: Celem niniejszego artykułu jest przedstawienie rywalizacji Chiny-Stany Zjednoczone w Azji Południowej przez pryzmat neorealizmu ofensywnego, który zakłada, że państwa dążą do maksymalizacji swojej potęgi. Artykuł analizuje strategie oraz główne narzędzia polityki zagranicznej Waszyngtonu i Pekinu w Azji Południowej od 2013 roku, w tym koncentrując się na koncepcji Indo-Pacyfiku i Inicjatywie Pasa i Szlaku (Belt and Road Initiative, BRI). Artykuł identyfikuje także reakcje państw Azji Południowej – zarówno mocarstw nuklearnych: Indii i Pakistanu, jak i mniejszych państw: Bangladeszu, Nepalu, Sri lanki i Malediwów – na rywalizację Stanów Zjednoczonych i Chin. W taki sposób artykuł wskazuje na lukę w literaturze i kluczowych teoriach stosunków międzynarodowych - które koncentrują się na mocarstwach, a kwestią wartą eksplorowanie są warunki wzrostu znaczenia średnich i małych państw.  Państwa te  mają na celu osiągnięcie jak największych korzyści z rywalizacji Stanów Zjednoczonych i Chin w regionie, współpracują z nimi bez opowiadania się po żadnej ze stron.

title: Ruch azowski i 15 Brygada Specjalnego Przeznaczenia Gwardii Narodowej Ukrainy „Azow” – związki i różnice, ideologiczne korzenie oraz ewolucja obu podmiotów do 2024 r.

ideologischen Wurzeln und den gegenseitigen Beziehungen zwischen der 15. Spezialeinheit der Nationalgarde der Ukraine „Asow” und der Asow-Bewegung sowie ihrer ideologischen Entwicklung im Kontext des Extremismus. und die Führer der Brigade an

This article explores the similarities and differences, ideological roots, and
relations between the 15th Special Forces Brigade “Azov” of the National Guard
of Ukraine and the Azov movement, as well as their ideological evolution in the
context of extremism. The text discusses: the impact of the Euromaidan revolution on the formation of “Azov”; the ideological inspirations of the founders of this
military unit and the entire Azov movement; the structure and significance of the
Azov movement; extremist groups linked to it, its international connections and
their relevance to its ideological position, as well as the internal situation within
the movement after 2021. The author argues that, although the military unit has
officially distanced itself from extremist content, many key individuals from both

title: Jak działa siła miękka Chin?: Przypadek Chińsko‑Pakistańskiego Korytarza Ekonomicznego

abstracts.content: Announced in 2013, the China–Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) is a multidimensional infrastructure project that has the potential to transform the Pakistani state and society. Under the CPEC umbrella, Beijing has expanded to an unprecedented extent own portfolio of soft power instruments vis-a-vis its “all-weather friend”, Pakistan. This article aims to analyze the potential of CPEC as a rich resource of China’s soft power. In the theoretical dimension, the paper juxtaposes Joseph Nye’s original conceptualization of soft power with selected literature on China’s soft power and Beijing’s practice. Empirically, the article first highlights the numerous soft power instruments deployed under the CPEC umbrella or related to this project. Second, this article outlines how the Pakistani government and society perceive China, CPEC and, where possible, specific instruments of China’s soft power. This case study draws attention to the nonmaterial aspects of China’s infrastructure projects that are often neglected. Thus, this study helps better understand this country’s growing importance in South Asia and beyond.

title: Attitudes towards the mother tongue among Roma in Poland

abstracts.content:
<jats:p>An assumption shared for years by Romani studies scholars is that the Roma language is seminal to the group’s identity. The text is an in-depth analysis of the beliefs of Roma in Poland regarding their mother tongue. The inspiration for this exploration stems from a theoretical model shedding light on correlations between knowledge of the Romani language and the Roma ethnic identity, the model Marushiakova and Popov developed with reference to the situation of Roma in Central Eastern Europe. The paper focuses on the question: What meaning do Roma in Poland assign to knowledge of the Romani language in the construction of their own ethnic identity? The authors argue that irrespective of the fact that the mother tongue currently appears to be a key element of group identity, Romaniness contains the potential to reproduce itself even under circumstances of language abandonment and even among the most conservative Romani groups.</jats:p>

title: Chapter  Kitsch in marketing. Merchandising and promotional activities in the retail sphere

abstracts.content: Business activities in the commercial sphere aim to optimise sales of specific goods. This chapter aims to investigate solutions in merchandising that fulfil the hallmarks of a kitsch experience. In the chapter, the author attempts to find answers to the following research questions: 1) What merchandising and sales promotion activities can be categorised as kitsch in trade? 2) What are the reasons and justification for using kitsch-like solutions in merchandising? and 3) To what extent does the use of kitsch in the commercial sphere meet consumers’ expectations? After a broad review of the literature with analytical and synthetic approaches, it can be concluded that the characteristics of kitsch are well suited to achieve the goals set for merchandising. The positive reception of the content and forms of kitsch by a significant proportion of buyers is also a favourable factor. However, ethical concerns arise regarding how buyers are misled in purchasing decisions.

The concepts drawn from international relations serve as a complementary layer to the political-science core of the analysis.

Over the last decade it has become clear that the tensions and conflicts within the Western world can no longer be interpreted merely as the result of some internal obstacles and dysfunctions which occur occasionally within each integrated and complex system, and which normally lead, in response, to undertake attempts of improving and reforming them. title: A Great Divide: Polish media discourse on migration, 2015–2018

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie: The analysis focuses on the Polish media discourse on migration in the years 2015–2018 as a space that both reflects and shapes political strategies and the mechanisms of managing the state’s internal security. Employing quantitative linguistic analysis (corpus linguistics) and qualitative critical discourse analysis (CDA), the authors reveal how different segments of the Polish media construct representations of migration, assigning them political and social meanings that contribute to the legitimisation of government actions and to the polarisation of public opinion.

A central place in the article is occupied by the concept of the securitisation of migration, which demonstrates how migration discourse becomes a tool for the politicisation of fear and for building support for specific security policies, as manifested in the narratives of both liberal and conservative press outlets. By highlighting the processes through which the media generate and sustain political divisions, as well as the role these mechanisms play in strengthening the position of the ruling party, the article positions itself within the discipline of political science and public administration, addressing issues related to instruments of societal influence and the management of threats within the state.

The study offers an insightful account of how communicative and discursive practices are closely intertwined with political and administrative processes, revealing the mechanisms through which the perception of risk is steered and how the issue of migration is used in public debate to advance political objectives.

The widely described migration crisis in Europe took place in 2015–2018. Like any major event, it was covered by the media in a variety of ways. While one could find analyses of the related media content for many European countries, a comprehensive study for Poland has not been previously conducted. This paper describes the Polish media’s divided positions on migration from 2015 to 2018. The media content analysis was based on the monitoring of the press, television, and the Internet. The following research techniques were used: (1) a summary of the number of messages over particular months to show the intensity of the phenomenon, (2) quantitative analysis employing corpus linguistics (CL), (3) qualitative analysis using critical discourse analysis (CDA). The analyses revealed a sharp divide between conservative and liberal discourses. These differences—tone, sentiment, and subject matter—were apparent in how the migration crisis was described. Conservative media only showed negative aspects of migration, and if there were no such issues in Poland, protests against migrants in Europe became their chosen topic. Liberal media much more often referred to the specificity of migration to Poland (economic migration from Ukraine) and showed the need for solidarity with migrants. However, the dominant difference was the political sympathies of individual media. We have shown divisions in media coverage based on this very factor. Tabloid coverage was not associated with any political party; it criticized the actions of the government and the opposition. However, the most critical perspective from which we want to describe the collected material is the securitization of migration. The subject of security is present in each analysed discourse, regardless of political divisions. Our research shows though that the intensity of threats is more significant in the right-wing press.

title: Dokumenty osobiste a doświadczenia migracji. Refleksje metodologiczne

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie:
Artykuł podejmuje refleksję nad metodą dokumentów osobistych w badaniach migracyjnych. Wpisuje się w ramy nauk socjologicznych poprzez zastosowanie metodologii charakterystycznej dla socjologii jakościowej, opartej na analizie tego typu materiałów. Dobór źródeł oraz refleksja teoretyczna osadzone są w klasycznych i współczesnych nurtach socjologii humanistycznej. 


Metoda pamiętnikarska (zwana też metodą dokumentów osobistych) jest często wykorzystywana
w roli narzędzia badania rzeczywistości społecznej, ale sama stosunkowo rzadko staje się
przedmiotem refleksji metodologicznej i teoretycznej. Tymczasem wciąż warte namysłu są podstawowe pytania, takie jak: co jest dokumentem osobistym? w jaki sposób może on być używany
i analizowany? jakie normy etyczne wiążą badacza? Prezentowany tekst porusza te kwestie,
przypominając klasyczne i współczesne ustalenia badaczy używających tej metody (np. zasada
współczynnika humanistycznego F. Znanieckiego), a następnie czyniąc pamiętnik Władka Wiśniewskiego zamieszczony w trzecim tomie Chłopa polskiego W. Thomasa i F. Znanieckiego
egzemplifikacją najważniejszych dylematów. Wskazanie ograniczenia najczęściej stosowanego
podejścia do dokumentów osobistych (traktowanych jako źródło wiedzy o obiektywnej rzeczywistości, jej wierne i neutralne „odbicie”) prowadzi do naszkicowania możliwości innego podejścia, zwanego pragmatycznym.

Biographical research is often used as a tool in studying social reality; however, this research
approach is hardly ever the object of theoretical and methodological reflections. Meanwhile,
even the most basic and fundamental research questions – What is considered a biographical
document? How can it be used and analysed? What ethical norms should the researcher abide to?
– are still worth discussing. The following paper addresses those questions while referring to
historical and contemporary findings made by researchers employing this approach (e.g., Florian
Znaniecki’s humanistic coefficient principle). Furthermore, the author discusses the memoir of
Władek Wiśniewski – included in the third volume of The Polish Peasant in Europe and America
by Florian Znaniecki and William Thomas – as the exemplification of the aforementioned issues.
The limitations of the most common approach to biographical documents (seen as an objective
source of information about the reality, its faithful and neutral reflection) allow the author to
suggests a different, pragmatical approach.

title: Auto-censura (self-censorship) – an ordinary and integral part of research life(?) Work in Progress in a form of an essay

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie:
The article addresses the issue of self-censorship in academia, treating it as a social phenomenon that affects research practices and scholarly communication. The author employs an autoethnographic perspective – typical of qualitative research in sociology – embedding the reflection in her own academic experience. The text offers an initial conceptualisation of the phenomenon and an invitation for further study, which situates it within the traditions of the sociology of knowledge and the sociology of science. The article is not merely a personal testimony but an attempt to initiate scholarly discourse on the invisible social mechanisms operating within the academic environment. The chosen research approach and thematic focus place the text unequivocally within the field of sociology.



This work-in-progress paper paves future research regarding the practice of autocensura (self-censorship). Starting from auto-biographical experience, the text shifts into a more theoretical reflection about this part of the scholarly work, which is hidden and unstudied. The working definition of the analyzed phenomenon aims to open an academic discussion about this practice. The paper ends with the call for testimonies and participation in the study.

title: Saudyjska Wizja 2030 i innowacje technologiczne zastosowane w inteligentnych miastach: casus Królestwa Arabii Saudyjskiej

abstracts.content:

Tekst przedstawia kompleksowe spojrzenie na proces transformacji Arabii Saudyjskiej w ramach strategii Vision 2030. Autorka ukazuje, jak państwo oparte dotąd niemal wyłącznie na dochodach z ropy, przeformułowuje swój model rozwoju, wdrażając wielowymiarowe reformy instytucjonalne i administracyjne. Analiza skupia się na działaniach podejmowanych przez saudyjskie władze w obszarze planowania publicznego, organizacji struktur nadzorujących megainwestycje oraz adaptacji polityk krajowych do standardów zrównoważonego rozwoju i gospodarki opartej na wiedzy. Szczególną uwagę zwraca sposób, w jaki Królestwo definiuje swoje priorytety technologiczne i cyfryzacyjne jako element szerszej polityki państwowej, wykorzystując projekty smart cities zarówno do budowy wizerunku, jak i kreowania nowych fundamentów społeczno-ekonomicznych. title: Perception of creative identities by artistic and non-artistic individuals: consequences for management

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie: Michał Szostak’s article, “Perception of creative identities by artistic and non-artistic individuals: consequences for management,” clearly falls within the field of management and quality studies. Justification: Creative identities in the context of management: The article focuses on how different groups (individuals with artistic and non-artistic profiles) perceive creative identities, which has a direct impact on human resource management in organisations. Perceptions of creativity are crucial for managing project teams, fostering innovation, and shaping organisational culture. Implications for management practice: The article presents management-related implications in areas such as recruiting and selecting creative employees, managing identity diversity within teams, and creating environments that support innovation. This makes the publication valuable for practitioners and scholars working in personnel management and organisational culture. Perception analysis as part of quality management: The way creative identity is perceived by others influences the quality of professional interactions, the effectiveness of teamwork, and the acceptance of innovative activities. Therefore, the article also addresses the soft aspects of organisational quality (relationships, communication, workplace cooperation). Methodology aligned with management sciences: The author employs a research approach based on analysing responses from participants with different profiles, which is typical of empirical studies in management. Differences in perception depending on experience and type of activity are examined, contributing to research on managing perceptions and attitudes within organisations. Application-focused orientation: Although the article draws on strong theoretical foundations (aesthetics and creativity psychology), its primary aim is to offer conclusions useful for leaders, managers, and organisations working with individuals who display diverse creative profiles—both in the cultural sector and beyond. In summary, the article clearly belongs to the field of management and quality studies because it: – analyses the perception of creativity in an organisational context, – provides insights useful for managing people and creative teams, – examines factors influencing the effectiveness and quality of collaboration, and – formulates practical recommendations for leaders and managers. It therefore fits within the domains of human capital management, organisational culture, and quality of the work environment.

The interdisciplinary research on the perception of creative identities like artists, cre-ators, entrepreneurs, leaders, and managers brings substantial conclusions for understanding the way of thinking, internal features, and motivations of decisions of individuals with and without artistic factor. For this purpose, an international quantitative examination of 160 individuals was undertaken. The research exhibited that individuals with and without artistic identity perceive artists, creators, entrepreneurs, leaders, and managers statistically similar (chi-square test of in-dependence used, p < 0.001). The negative verification of the hypotheses was astonishing and a novelty in the investigated area. The novelty should be seen as an artistic potential existing in each individual. The additional qualitative analysis of the 50 features constituting the investigated identities revealed that individuals with and without artistic identity see particular features of these identities slightly differently (the most important, the least important, and the most equally perceived features were described in detail). The outcomes were discussed with the literature on the subject, confirming most other researchers’ theses and revealing some contradictions and can be used to understand the qualities of artistic identity and the perception of investigated identities by individuals, groups, and societies dominated by persons with and without artistic factors. The applicability of the results is broad, mainly due to the role of artistry in today’s world as potential laying in every individual. Specific triggers should be catalyzed instead of looking for artist-born individuals. The education process of artists should focus on revealing artistic potential underlin-ing the role of inspiration, and discovering the motifs of artistic activity.

title: The primary drivers of private-sphere pro-environmental behaviour in five European countries during the Covid-19 pandemic

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie: The article is situated within the field of sociology by demonstrating how individuals’ pro-environmental attitudes and behaviours are rooted in social structures and shaped by the dominant value patterns and cultural norms present in the studied countries. Drawing on extensive survey data from five European societies, the authors analyse how the willingness to engage in environmental protection reflects processes of attitudinal internalisation and adaptation to collective expectations. The findings point to the significant role of biospheric values and relationships with nature, which form the social foundation for sustainable everyday practices. The article also emphasises the importance of the COVID-19 pandemic as a collective experience that may strengthen environmental awareness and openness to pro-ecological innovations. In this way, the study enriches sociological reflection on the social mechanisms shaping attitudes toward nature and reveals how, under the influence of global challenges, notions of individual responsibility for the environment are being transformed.



Nowadays, when fighting climate change and other global environmental issues is of utmost urgency, the understanding of what drives pro-environmental behaviour has become a hot topic in both academic and practical circles. Some earlier studies unravelled the complexity of the underlying factors of pro-environmental conduct, yet more studies are needed to understand the socio-cultural premises of such behaviour in different countries. The main aim of this paper is to offer a comprehensive analysis of the importance of pro-environmental behaviour drivers across five countries in Europe, namely Greece, Poland, Portugal, Sweden, and the United Kingdom. The survey using computer-assisted web interviews (N = 2502) was implemented in July 2020, the first summer of the Covid-19 pandemic. Hierarchical linear models were employed to analyse individuals’ behaviour, defined as self-perceived declaration of the willingness to contribute to environmental conservation. The results showed that attitudinal and value-related factors are more significant than demographics. Biospheric values and relationship to nature generally affect pro-environmental behaviour positively. Similarly, the experience of Covid-19 exerted a positive influence. In terms of country-level predictors, greenhouse gas emissions were found to have affected pro-environmental behaviour negatively, while the share of renewable energy sources influenced it positively. The cumulative country Covid-19-related mortality at the time of investigation did not have discernible impact. Based on the results it is suggested that, in order to foster PEB, a stronger emphasis on environmental education and attitudes towards nature should be employed.

title: Elucidating human–nature connectedness in three EU countries: A pro-environmental behaviour perspective

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie: The study demonstrates how the human relationship with nature becomes a reflection of the underlying mechanisms of social sensitivity shaped by gender roles, levels of prosperity, and patterns of altruism characteristic of particular societies. By analysing nature connectedness in Poland, Greece, and Sweden, the authors reveal that a bond with nature does not arise solely from physical contact with the environment but primarily from how individuals integrate biospheric values into their place within social structures and cultural narratives. The article highlights that attitudes toward nature function as a sociological indicator of deeper processes—such as the internalisation of environmental norms or the construction of identity through the lens of responsibility toward the community. This insightful perspective on human–nature relations makes the article a significant contribution to understanding social transformations in the era of environmental challenges, a core area of sociological inquiry.

Strengthening positive human–nature relationships is seen as a way to more pro-environmental behaviour and leads to a greater environmental sustainability. Therefore, understanding human–nature relationships has attracted increasing attention among researchers. Nature connectedness is a concept developed to measure such relationships. Since nature connectedness is complex and context dependent phenomenon, more research comparing sociocultural and environmental factors within societies in different countries is needed to understand its determinants. In this study, we explored how sociodemographic and socioeconomic characteristics and value orientation of respondents and environmental variables affected nature connectedness across different contexts in the European Union. We used 11 sociodemographic, socioeconomic and personal value factors from the computer-assisted web interview (CAWI) and six environmental variables characterizing the local environments of 1054 respondents as independent variables to explain the nature connectedness of the respondents in Greece, Poland and Sweden. The individual level of nature connectedness (response variable) was expressed by an additive index (NC-index) based on a 5-item scale originating from CAWI. The general additive model was applied to link NC-index to sociodemographic, value orientation and selected environmental variables. We found that the sociodemographic characteristics of the respondents and their value orientation were substantially more important in explaining the individual level of nature connectedness than environmental variables. The NC-index was positively correlated with the frequency of visits to the natural environment and biospheric values of the respondents, and was higher for women and the most prosperous respondents. Moreover, we observed several country-wise differences in associations between explanatory variables and NC-index. For example, altruistic orientation was positively related to the level of nature connectedness only in Greece, but not in two other countries, and residence during childhood was important to nature connectedness only in Sweden. Our findings that some sociodemographic, socioeconomic and value orientation variables affect the level of individual nature connectedness across studied countries are encouraging. They indicate that some universally applied educational actions may elevate the level of nature connectedness. We argue that exploration of nature connectedness from a cross-country perspective may provide significant insights into the environmental debate in national and international contexts. title: The role of hyperactive Twitter accounts in the diffusion of political information

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie: Autorzy bada zjawisko rozprzestrzeniania informacji politycznych w sieciach społecznych (Twitter) oraz rolę, jaką odgrywają w tym tzw. konta hiperaktywne. Jest to analiza procesów komunikacji społecznej, oddziaływań między aktorami społecznymi (liderzy opinii - użytkownicy - boty/cyborgi), a także mechanizmów wpływu społecznego, jakimi są np. społeczne potwierdzenie (social endorsement), czy zarażanie społeczne – czyli typowe obszary zainteresowania socjologii mediów i komunikacji. W artykule autorzy odnoszą się do fundamentalnych pojęć i teorii socjologicznych: koncepcji liderów opinii (Katz i Lazarsfeld), efektu Mateusza (Merton) oraz teorii zarażania społecznego (Centola i Macy). Cytowane są także współczesne badania z zakresu socjologii internetu, socjologii polityki i socjologii informacji. Ponadto, rola hiperaktywnych kont analizowana jest w kontekście kampanii politycznej, co stanowi obszar socjologii polityki. W szczególności badane są kwestie związane z manipulacją informacyjną i kontrolą nad przestrzenią publiczną online, czyli zjawiska interesujące współczesną socjologię władzy i mediów. Same pytania badawcze oraz hipotezy mają charakter empiryczny i społeczny. Dotyczą zachowań zbiorowych, wpływu społecznego oraz struktury oddziaływań w przestrzeni publicznej. Podsumowując, artykuł analizuje procesy społeczne zachodzące w sferze komunikacji politycznej online, z zastosowaniem narzędzi analizy danych jako wsparcia dla socjologicznej interpretacji, co jest typowe dla współczesnej interdyscyplinarnej socjologii cyfrowej.

Social media virality is intertwined with content’s ability to trigger specific reactions; however, little is known regarding the behavioural component of political information diffusion. This study uses big data to investigate the significance of hyperactive social media use in the retransmission of information produced by political opinion leaders on Twitter during Poland’s 2019 European parliamentary election campaign. Using the isolation forest method, the research identified the social bot-like (semi)automated or human-controlled Twitter handles which are referred to as hyperactive accounts. The study finds that the hyperactive accounts produced almost all reactions in our sample (N = 114,036), but their average activity was relatively moderate and did not exceed human capabilities. Although their retweets equal 0.46% of the retweets obtained by political opinion leaders, the random forest regression models suggest that the likes and retweets from hyperactive accounts are the most important determinants of the dissemination of political opinion leaders’ tweets. The results draw attention to the alarming phenomenon of the further increase in Twitter’s interactional asymmetry.

title: Beyond the Reality Principle: On the Political Role of Imagination in Herbert Marcuse’s Libidinal Economy

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie:
Artykuł dotyczy myśli społecznej Herberta Marcusego, jednego z klasyków socjologii, myśliciela należącego do kręgu szkoły frankfurckiej. Artykuł został opublikowany w numerze monograficznym zatytułowanym „Herbert Marcuse i nowa polityka” jako pokłosie seminarium poświęconego teoriom nowej lewicy i aktualności pracy poświęconej krytyce społeczeństwa konsumpcyjnego „Człowiek jednowymiarowy” 1991. Analiza przeprowadzona w tekście dotyczy roli wyobraźni społecznej jako narzędzia zmiany politycznej. Wyobraźnia jest dla Marcusego jedynym sposobem przełamania codziennej rutyny i wytworzenia dodatkowych wymiarów w naszym postrzeganiu kapitalistycznej rzeczywistości, w której zarówno przedmioty i idee są dla konsumentów towarami.  


Według tradycji psychoanalitycznej funkcjonujemy w świecie społecznym dzięki zasadzie rzeczywistości. Artykuł będzie dotyczył roli wyobraźni jako siły politycznej, siły przekształcającej ramy rzeczywistości społecznej ożywianej przez historyczną modyfikację tej zasady - zasadę wydajności. Ze względu na to, że – jak pokazał to Marcuse - rozum stał się elementem dominacji, jedyną siłą emancypacyjną, zdolną przeciwstawić się codziennej rutynie i powtarzalności jest wyobraźnia. Proponujemy zatem rozwinięcie tej idei wyobraźni jako środka wyzwolenia z jednowymiarowego świata i przemiany świata społecznego w kontekście nowej ekonomii libidinalnej zarysowanej przez G.H. Marcusego w dwóch pracach: Eros i cywilizacja oraz Człowiek jednowymiarowy.

title: Polityka pozainstytucjonalna czy antyinstytucjonalna? Socjologiczne ujęcie ruchów społecznych

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie:
Artykuł stanowi socjologiczną refleksję nad współczesnymi ruchami społecznymi, ukazując je jako kluczowy czynnik przekształceń polityki poza- i antyinstytucjonalnej. Autor osadza analizę w perspektywie socjologii konfliktu, odnosząc się do klasycznych i współczesnych teorii ruchów społecznych, w tym koncepcji Touraine’a i Wieviorki, które łączą badania empiryczne z budowaniem teorii. Podejście to pozwala ukazać ruchy społeczne jako dynamiczne procesy społeczne kształtujące nowe pola konfliktów kulturowych i redefiniujące relacje władzy. Przykłady zaczerpnięte z polskich realiów ostatniej dekady służą ilustracji mechanizmów autotransformacji społeczeństwa i jego historyczności. Tym samym tekst jednoznacznie mieści się w ramach nauk socjologicznych, wnosząc wkład w pogłębione rozumienie społecznych źródeł i konsekwencji politycznej kontestacji. 


<jats:p>Artykuł „Polityka pozainstytucjonalna czy antyinstytucjonalna? Socjologiczne ujęcie ruchów społecznych” poświęcony jest ruchom społecznym, które tworzą rosnący obszar polityki pozainstytucjonalnej, będącej odpowiedzią na porażkę klasycznych instytucji tworzących ład demokratyczny. Socjologiczna perspektywa wybrana przez autora  uwzględnia również zjawisko ruchów antyspołecznych, nazywanych też antyruchami społecznymi, które nie stronią od przemocy i nabierają rozpędu, wykorzystując nową przestrzeń publiczną, jaką jest Internet. Ich wpływy rosną, zasilając tych polityków, którzy swoją popularność budują na populizmie i ultranacjonalizmie, jak Putin, Trump, Bolsonaro czy Orban. Przykłady polityki pozainstytucjonalnej i antyinstytucjonalnej w Polsce odnoszą się do ostatnich 10 lat, kiedy znacznie wzrosła liczba ruchów protestacyjnych i ugrupowań radykalnych.

The article “Non-institutional or anti-institutional policy? Sociological approach to social movements” is devoted to social movements that create a growing area of non-institutional politics, which is a response to the failure of classical institutions creating a democratic order. The sociological perspective chosen by the author also takes into account the phenomenon movements, called also social anti-movements, that do not shy away from violence and gain momentum by using the new public space that is the Internet. Their influence is growing, powering those politicians who build their popularity on populism and ultra-nationalism, like Putin, Trump, Bolsonaro and Orban. Examples of non-institutional and anti-institutional politics in Poland refer to the last 10 years, when the number of protest movements and radical groups has increased significantly.</jats:p>

title: Boredom and Power: How Power Relations Influence Feeling Boredom

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie: The article presents boredom as a social emotion rather than solely a psychological or existential state of the individual, analysing its sources and functions in the context of social relations and power structures. The author argues that boredom can serve as a tool of control and subordination, reflecting status inequalities and social mechanisms of domination. This approach is grounded in the sociology of emotions and theories of social interaction. The applied perspective depicts emotions as shaped by social conditions rather than as purely individual experiences.

The paper advocates the claim that boredom is not only a psychological state or existential mood but a social emotion produced and reproduced in the process of interactions between people as individuals, people displaying specific social roles, or social groups. Moreover, as argued in the article, the feeling of boredom is particularly characteristic of power relations. Therefore, boredom is hypothesized to be a matter of interactional/social position – its experiencing is influenced by one’s social status. The power to produce boredom in others usually reflects a higher social position, and in some situations, causing others to be bored can constitute a deliberate or unintentional method of keeping others in a submissive position by limiting their sense of agency – thus a tool for gaining/maintaining power and social control.

title: Znikanie etnosu i nowe formy walki o tożsamość: wschodnioromańscy mieszkańcy Istrii

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie:
Artykuł ukazuje intensywne procesy społeczne i kulturowe prowadzące do zaniku odrębności językowej oraz głębokiej transformacji tożsamości wschodnioromańskich grup Istrii, koncentrując się na ich miejscu w lokalnej hierarchii oraz relacjach z otoczeniem społecznym. Autorka analizuje mechanizmy integracji i asymilacji w kontekście społecznych układów sił, uwzględniając także działania lokalnej inteligencji zmierzające do odbudowy regionalnej świadomości. Zastosowane metody badań terenowych, choć zakorzenione częściowo w tradycji antropologicznej, służą przede wszystkim uchwyceniu procesów społecznych i zjawisk tożsamościowych istotnych dla socjologii. Tym samym artykuł sytuuje się przede wszystkim w polu nauk socjologicznych, oferując pogłębione spojrzenie na dynamikę zaniku i odbudowy tożsamości w ramach lokalnych układów społecznych, a także na sposoby, w jakie grupy mniejszościowe redefiniują swoje miejsce i role w zmieniającym się otoczeniu społecznym. 


Artykuł  jest  oparty  na  dwóch  intensywnych  antropologicznych  badaniach  terenowych. Poświęcony jest gwałtownie zachodzącym procesom kulturowym wśród zbiorowości posługujących się do nie-dawna (a obecnie szczątkowo) wschodnioromańskimi dialektami wśród mieszkańców Istrii, tracących tożsa-mość językową, „rozpływających się” wśród chorwackiej większości, ulegających radykalnej integracji toż-samościowej i asymilacji do narodowej kultury chorwackiej. Interesuje mnie nie tyle historyczne pochodzenie grupy, ile jej samookreślenie, jak się okazuje, skomplikowana tożsamość wewnętrzna zbiorowości a także po-dejmowane przez lokalną inteligencję próby jej regeneracji poprzez naukę regionalnego języka romańskiego. Uwzględniony zostaje także aspekt miejsca w hierarchii społecznej lokalnych grup wschodnioromańskich Istrii w oczach sąsiadów i kulturowa walka o jego zmianę.

The paper is based on the results of two anthropological researches conducted within the communities living in the Istria Peninsula. Until recently they have used specific local Eastern Romance dialects. The text is dedicated to the process of violent changes which endangered the existence of this population in the context of its language and identity. The described groups are being assimilated and integrated to the Croatian-speaking majority and Croatian national culture. On the base of interviews with representatives of local communities from Žejane and Šušnjevica the historical traditions, social status of these groups and the character of their relations with neighbouring population will be described. Moreover, social and educational activities towards the cultural revival of these communities, taken by the local intelligentsia, will be discussed.

title: Creativity management within the aesthetical situation regarding the in-real or digital form of participation in arts: art receivers’ perspective.

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie: The scientific article “Creativity Management within the Aesthetical Situation Regarding the In-Real or Digital Form of Participation in Arts: Art Receivers’ Perspective” by Michał Szostak and Łukasz Sułkowski clearly falls within the field of management and quality studies. Management of creativity and cultural participation: The authors focus on managing creativity and the quality of aesthetic experience in the context of different forms of participation in the arts (in-person vs digital). They assess how the form of participation influences the perception of artistic value and creativity—directly relating to the management of creative processes and the reception of cultural products. Interdisciplinary approach with a distinct managerial component: Although the article refers to aesthetics and culture, its foundation lies in managing technological change and digitalisation in the cultural sector. It addresses issues related to audience management, the adaptation of artists and cultural managers to digital distribution formats, and the effectiveness of these formats in terms of engagement and satisfaction. Purposefulness and optimisation in arts management: The study analyses specific indicators of the quality of participation in the arts (e.g., satisfaction, engagement, comfort), which are then used to formulate practical recommendations for managing the distribution of artworks and adjusting participation formats to audience expectations and capacities. Use of research tools typical of management studies: The article is based on quantitative data analysis (surveys, SPSS statistics, Excel) and qualitative methods (literature analysis using NVivo), all of which are characteristic of management research. The authors use modelling, evaluation of quality indicators, and comparative analysis to improve decision-making and management processes in the cultural context. Relevance to management practice in cultural institutions: The article is addressed not only to academics but also to cultural managers, artists, and policymakers. It has an applied character, offering insights that may support better management of cultural institutions and the adaptation of strategies to evolving technological and social conditions. Connection to the quality of audience experiences: Assessing the quality of participation in the arts in relation to the mode of engagement is directly linked to the quality of cultural services, aligning with managerial research on customer experience and service quality. In sum, the article belongs to the domain of management and quality studies because it investigates the impact of digital transformation on the management of cultural participation, measures the quality of audience experiences, and provides practical recommendations for optimising processes in cultural institutions. It combines aesthetic theory with managerial tools, making it a valuable contribution to interdisciplinary research on creativity management and the quality of cultural services.

Because digitalisation of the aesthetical experience, a process speeded up by the not-yet-finished COVID-19 pandemic, should be considered in the context of growth or loss of artistry/creativity, this paper aims to assess the influence of the participation form in the aesthetical situation by receivers on the level of artistry/creativity potential loss. Assessment of the quality of participation by the receivers in each of five types of arts (musical arts, performing arts, literary arts, audio-visual arts, visual arts) was done using the same ten criteria for each type of art: satisfaction, pleasure, engagement, the possibility of experiencing cathar-sis, contact with the artwork itself, contact with the performer itself, comfort of participation, possibilities of shaping the aesthetical experience, own motivation to participate, easiness of participation. The literature review was run using NVivo Pro software. Data analysis (n = 221) was executed using IBM SPSS and Microsoft Excel. Answering the research hypotheses: H1) the digital form of participation in arts determines the level of quality of participation in the aesthetical situation by receivers; H2) the form of participation in art shapes the level of quality of participation in the aesthetical situation by receivers of each type of art differently: in musical arts, performing arts, literary arts and visual arts, in-real participation gives higher quality than digital participation; in audio-visual arts, in-real participation gives lower quality than digital participation. The research results may be helpful for: art creators wanting to choose the optimal way of distributing their artworks; art managers to better understand art receivers’ perspectives and their opinion about participation in arts in real or digitally; art receivers to compare their private opinion about the ways of participation in arts with the general opinion of art receivers.

title: Nieheteronormatywne taktyki reprodukcyjne we współczesnej Polsce

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie: Tekst ukazuje jak osoby nieheteronormatywne w Polsce, funkcjonując w polu wykluczających przepisów i dominującego dyskursu heteronormatywnego, konstruują własne scenariusze rodzicielstwa. Autorka, posługując się narzędziami socjologii jakościowej i teorią codziennych praktyk de Certeau, analizuje złożone strategie i taktyki reprodukcyjne, poprzez które badane osoby negocjują społeczne i prawne ramy swojej rodziny. Tekst wnika w relacje między normatywnym porządkiem prawnym a codziennymi wyborami oraz pokazuje, jak w obrębie tego napięcia wyłaniają się nowe formy rodzinności i redefinicje więzi pokrewieństwa. Szczególną wartością artykułu jest uwzględnienie perspektywy uczestników badań, ich narracji o ambiwalencjach, ryzykach i kreatywnych obejściach istniejących barier. Dzięki temu artykuł dostarcza krytycznego wglądu w mechanizmy reprodukcji i przekształcania norm społecznych, co sytuuje go w centrum współczesnej refleksji socjologicznej nad rodziną, płcią i strukturami władzy. 



Podczas gdy na Zachodzie mówi się obecnie coraz częściej o reprodukcyjnym normatywizmie (repronormativity) wśród osób nieheteroseksualnych, co jest związane z prawnym rozpoznaniem i ochroną ich rodzicielstwa, w Polsce ich możliwości zostania rodzicami są bardzo ograniczone. Pronatalistyczna polityka państwa regulująca dostęp do technik wspomaganej reprodukcji jest selektywna, heteronormatywna i wykluczająca. Wystarczy wspomnieć, że Ustawa o leczeniu niepłodności z 2015 roku ustala możliwości korzystania z usług klinik leczenia niepłodności w Polsce jedynie dla par heteroseksualnych pozostających w związku małżeńskim bądź wspólnym pożyciu. Pary jednopłciowe chcące wychowywać dziecko mają więc ograniczone przez prawo możliwości realizacji swoich planów reprodukcyjnych, a gdy już dziecko wychowują, borykają się z nierozpoznaniem charakteru własnej rodziny, a szczególnie więzi łączących dziecko z rodzicem społecznym. W artykule autorka pokazuje, w jaki sposób osoby nieheteroseksualne w Polsce, mimo tych ograniczeń, zostają rodzicami. Jakie strategie reprodukcyjne wybierają? Jakie luki prawne wykorzystują? Jakie czynniki mają wpływ na ich wybór? Odwołuje się przy tym do wyników projektu badawczego Rodziny z wyboru w Polsce, którym autorka kierowała w latach 2013-2016.

title: Taking Stock: A Socio-Economic Assessment of Moldova’s Europeanisation in Light of Its EU Membership Prospects

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie: The article analyses the prospects of Moldova’s membership in the European Union primarily through the lens of the functioning of its political system, the effectiveness of public institutions, and the administrative capacity to absorb and consolidate EU standards. The text discusses in detail how a weak social contract, an economy burdened by post-Soviet legacies, and a high degree of political polarization influence political processes and the effectiveness of meeting accession requirements such as the Copenhagen criteria and negotiations within the acquis clusters. The author emphasises that it is the quality of state structures, the mechanisms of governance and public administration, and the capacity to implement policies aligned with EU principles that most strongly determine the pace and stability of Moldova’s Europeanisation. In this way, by firmly situating the issue within the political and administrative analysis of state transformation, the article fully belongs to the discipline of political science and public administration.


Purpose: Moldova is a country with strong aspirations to join the European Union (EU), however, as a transition state it still has socio-economic structures resistant to the types of reforms needed to become an EU member. The goal of this article is to explore the Republic of Moldova’s EU membership prospects. The purpose is to highlight Moldova’s current progress towards EU accession criteria and the challenges and domestic roadblocks that stand in the way. Design/Methodology/Approach: The article develops a novel socio-economic approach and adopts the concept of ‘europeanisation’ to understand Moldova’s evolving alignment with the EU. A qualitative approach is pursued which relies on content analysis of key documents, economic data, civil society reports, and interviews with EU and Moldovan officials carried out in 2022 and 2023. Findings: Findings reveal a positive reform dynamic and strong political will, but at the same time critical shortcomings and weaknesses. By ‘digging deep’ into the domestic context of Moldova’s EU membership aspirations the article identifies three socio-economic structural features resulting from its characteristics as a transition state; a weak social contract, an economy shaped by legacies of the past and political polarisation, all of which have significant consequences for the country’s EU accession. Practical Implications: The practical implications of the findings suggest that plans to realise Moldova’s EU accession in 2030 are optimistic and the desire for a quick accession process to meet urgent geopolitical imperatives could mean that serious socio-economic structural problems are ignored. Findings also suggest that the EU needs to redouble its efforts to help Moldovans re-build their social contract, tackle the informal economy, and emphasise de-oligarchisation to enhance the country’s socio-economic resilience. Originality/Value: The value of the article comes from its timeliness and novel socio-economic approach, as such, the article contributes to filling the current research gap.

title: Academia as a driver of change: a bibliometric analysis of pro-environmental behavior in higher education institutions

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie:
Both the topic – social determinants and institutional frameworks of pro-environmental behaviours (PEB) in higher education institutions (HEIs) – and the methods employed (bibliometrics/sociology of science, content analysis) position the article within the discipline of sociology. The text aligns with the paradigm of environmental sociology, and its aims –understanding and supporting social change toward sustainable development – are consistent with my scholarly output and research profile. The article provides a comprehensive overview of studies on pro-environmental behaviours (PEB) in higher education, emphasising the social processes and cultural patterns through which universities shape the norms and practices of sustainable development. By analysing dominant research strands – from value- and intention-based behaviours to green organisational practices – the authors demonstrate how universities act as key actors in fostering pro-ecological attitudes and embedding them within collective consciousness. The findings highlight that universities, as social institutions, bear responsibility not only for implementing environmental policies but also for shaping values and behavioural patterns that extend beyond the boundaries of the campus. By situating the analysis of PEB within the broader context of social responsibility, norm formation, and the transformation of collective practices, the article clearly falls within the research domain of the sociological sciences.

title: The opioid crisis in Poland? Insights from online forum data

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie:
The aim of the article is not to demonstrate the medical consequences of opioid use but to examine whether the narrative of a supposed crisis is reflected in social behaviours and discourse. The article challenges alarmist media narratives by presenting an alternative, socially grounded analysis based on data from online forums. This approach aligns with classical themes in the sociology of moral panic and the social construction of problems. In particular, the study asks how the number of users and the frequency of opioid-related discussions changed over time, how the online community responded to the COVID-19 pandemic, and whether early signs of a crisis could be detected in online discourse. These are, therefore, questions about processes and collective social reactions.

The study is based on content analysis of an internet forum and employs natural language processing (NLP), change-point detection, and time-series analysis. These methods are used to explore social trends and communicative practices, which also positions the work within digital sociology, examining social life in virtual environments.

Although the topic of the article references a health-related issue, the adopted perspective is unequivocally sociological. In addition to the subdisciplines mentioned above, the article is situated within the sociology of the internet, the sociology of health, culture, and deviance.


Background
In recent years, Polish media have raised alarms about the growing opioid threat. However, the latest research challenges these concerns, indicating a lack of factual evidence about the rise in the treatment and consumption of opioids. The present research contributes to this debate by analyzing online discussion trends on the Hyperreal—the most significant Polish forum for debating psychoactive substances. The aim is to verify whether online user discussions reflect—or contradict—concerns about an emerging opioid crisis in Poland, and how such discussions may complement other forms of data.
Methods
The study is based on 1,174,816 Hyperreal posts from its start in 2005 to 2023, of which 208,768 were related to opioids. Text data were cleaned and lemmatized. We conducted a time series analysis to track changes in posts, mentions, user numbers, and the proportion of opioid-related posts relative to overall forum content.
Results
Our analysis showed that codeine was the most popular opioid on the forum, while fentanyl and oxycodone—reported by the media as spreading in Poland—did not garner much attention. Overall, throughout the 20 years, the discussions on opioids remained at a stable level, with a decline in posts and users since 2021, and other topics becoming more frequent.
Conclusion
The findings suggest that media narratives may be exaggerated and offer additional support for the view that Poland is currently not experiencing the early stages of a crisis. Nonetheless, we emphasize the need for further research on actual opioid consumption patterns.

title: Russian-Ukrainian War. Insights from modern conflicts focusing on the Polish Territorial Defense Forces through a polemology and irenology approach

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie: The article addresses key issues of state security policy and the organization of defence structures in the context of contemporary armed conflicts. It employs an interdisciplinary approach (polemology and irenology), analysing the functioning of the Territorial Defence Forces of the Republic of Poland as an instrument of state policy under conditions of hybrid warfare and prolonged military threat. The main axis of the analysis concerns political decision-making, the organization of defence systems, civil–military relations, and the administrative dimensions of crisis management, all of which fall directly within the substantive scope of the discipline of political science and public administration.

In addition, the article reflects on processes of security institutionalisation, deterrence strategy, and state response models to systemic and asymmetric challenges, making it relevant to research on defence policy, public decision-making theory, and public policy analysis in the field of national security.

Objectives:
This study explores the impact of the Russo-Ukrainian War on Poland’s Territorial Defence Forces (TDF), focusing on their adaptation to hybrid threats and expanded civil-military roles. Through comparison with defence models in Finland, Israel, and Ukraine, it proposes measures to strengthen resilience, decentralisation, and societal integration.

Material and methods:
The study used a qualitative approach combining polemology and irenology.Methods included analysis of official documents,11 expert interviews (with TDF officers, civil defence managers, analysts), and comparative study of Ukraine, Finland, and Israel. Clausewitz’s strategic depth and Galtung’s violence typologies framed the analysis. Despite limited access to operational data, triangulation ensured validity. Findings focus on hybrid defence, civil-military integration, and regional security architecture.

Results:
TDF development shows progress in hybrid readiness, drone use, and community-based defence. Strategic areas—ports, rivers, and borderlands—require more brigades. Recruitment faces challenges due to lack of employer support. Modular, short-term training is gaining interest. TDF’s social role has grown—supporting crisis response, disinformation and psychological resilience. Comparative insights highlight the value of decentralised, civic-anchored defence systems.

Conclusions:
The study confirms that effective defence must combine kinetic capacity with civil resilience. TDF’s evolving role—military, social, and symbolic—demands expanded deployment (e.g., 30 brigades in key zones) and full integration into national cybersecurity and crisis systems. Combatting “cultural lies” and strengthening civic trust are vital. TDF represents a shift toward multi-domain deterrence, bridging state and society, warfighting and peacebuilding.

title: From Poland to Canada: The Life and Activity of Zygmunt Rusinek (1893–1984)

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie: Biographies of politicians, diplomats, and state officials are not only accounts of individual lives but also testimonies to the political, institutional, and ideological mechanisms of a given era. Zygmunt Rusinek, as a political activist, public official, and émigré, operated within the sphere of politics both domestically (in the Second Polish Republic and the government-in-exile) and internationally (as an emigrant in Canada). The article employs a political-science perspective that enables an analysis of the protagonist’s life as a case study of individual agency operating within a changing political reality.

Furthermore, the article examines the political thought of the figure in question, drawing on selected methodological tools from political science (applying categories of political thought). The narrative also relies on several theoretical definitions used in political science: the article presents political-science approaches to diaspora, national identity, and political emigration.

Zygmunt Rusinek (1893–1984) was a distinguished politician and social activist who played a significant role in the political life of Poland during three crucial periods of the twentieth century: the interwar period, the Second World War, and the postwar era in exile. Above all, he held a prominent and influential position in the Polish government-in-exile in the late 1940s and early 1950s, where he headed the Ministry of Affairs of Polish Citizens Abroad, a department established specifically for him. This article explores Rusinek’s contributions to the Polish government-in-exile during this period and his efforts to preserve the continuity of the pre-war state. In particular, it focuses on Rusinek’s impact on social policy concerning Polish citizens abroad, especially during his three terms as minister. Furthermore, this article also evaluates the scope of his activities during the Second World War. It details his extensive involvement with the Polish diaspora in Canada, where, as a journalist, he became notably recognized for promoting Polish culture. This study addresses a significant gap in historiography by endeavouring to reconstruct the life and work of a political figure who, while often operating in the background of political life, exerted considerable influence on contemporary events. This article engages with the multifaceted nature of Rusinek’s activities, which transcended his personal views and ideological stance to further the cause of Polish independence. Moreover, it sheds light on his role in the history of Polish political emigration during the Cold War era.

title: Artificial intelligence in aesthetic situation management: new solutions supporting or substituting an art creator

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie:
Artykuł wpisuje się w zakres dyscypliny nauki o zarządzaniu i jakości w obszarze estetyki 
zarządzania, zarządzania humanistycznego oraz zarządzania sztuką, ponieważ dotyczy 
zarządzania sytuacją estetyczną w kontekście zastosowania sztucznej inteligencji – a więc 
zagadnienia obejmującego procesy planowania, organizowania, kierowania i kontrolowania 
elementów procesu twórczego w kontekście artystycznym oraz relacji między uczestnikami
owej sytuacji. Artykuł wykorzystuje podejście menedżerskie do analizy problemu badawczego, 
traktując twórcę jako menedżera sytuacji estetycznej, co stanowi przykład interdyscyplinarnego 
zastosowania metod i kategorii zarządzania w obszarze sztuki i jej kulturotwórczego znaczenia. 
Ponadto artykuł rozwija refleksję nad rolą technologii w procesach zarządzania twórczością 
i wartością estetyczną, co mieści się w nurcie współczesnych badań nad zarządzaniem 
innowacjami, jakością doświadczenia i wpływem sztucznej inteligencji na praktyki 
organizacyjne i decyzyjne


The article aims to define and describe potential areas of an aesthetic situation in
which artificial intelligence may be applied in supporting or substituting roles. Analysing relations
between artist, artwork, art recipient, the world of values, and the real world – based
on the components of the aesthetic situation theory by Maria Gołaszewska in the Outline of
Aesthetics (orig. Zarys estetyki, first published in 1984) and its development by applying the
managerial lens by Michał Szostak in the Art of Management – Management of Art (orig. Sztuka
zarządzania – zarządzanie sztuką, first published in 2023), allows to define particular universal
areas of an aesthetic situation where artificial intelligence may be applied. The central
methodological approach is a literature review on an aesthetic situation, aesthetic situation
management, and artificial intelligence and its use in aesthetic situation management. The
analysis results define two groups of artificial intelligence roles within an aesthetic situation:
supporting and substituting. Both roles are described in detail based on aesthetic situation
components and their management by an artist who is considered a manager of the aesthetic
situation. Limitations of the considerations and directions of future research are defined.

title: Ruch Kapitanów i geneza rewolucji portugalskiej (1973-1974)

abstracts.content:
Uzasadnienie:
Artykuł, choć opublikowany w „Kwartalniku Historycznym”, wyrasta z pola refleksji politologicznej. Interesuje mnie w nim nie tylko sekwencja wydarzeń prowadzących do upadku dyktatury, ale sam mechanizm przekształcenia władzy – sposób, w jaki struktura państwa autorytarnego ulega erozji pod wpływem presji instytucjonalnej, społecznej i militarnej. Opis Ruchu Kapitanów traktuję więc jako studium procesu politycznego: narodzin nowego ośrodka legitymizacji i przejścia od autorytaryzmu do demokracji. 
Analizując motywacje, decyzje i zależności między armią, elitą władzy a społeczeństwem, posługuję się kategoriami właściwymi naukom o polityce – teorią reżimów, logiką transformacji ustrojowej, problemem legitymacji i instytucjonalizacji zmian. Tłem nie jest historia reżimu, lecz funkcjonowanie państwa i jego aparatów w sytuacji kryzysu władzy. 
Z tego powodu artykuł należy rozumieć jako pracę z zakresu nauk o polityce i administracji – analizującą zjawisko polityczne w kategoriach strukturalnych i decyzyjnych, a nie jako klasyczne opracowanie historyczne.

title: Social researchers’ approaches to research ethics during the COVID-19 pandemic : an exploratory study

abstracts.content: <jats:p> The global COVID-19 pandemic and quarantine/distancing measures have forced researchers to cope with a new situation. This paper aimed to analyze how the pandemic and its associated constraints have affected social researchers’ approach to research ethics. Drawing on an online qualitative survey with 193 Polish social researchers conducted in April and May 2020, we distinguished three approaches: nothing has changed, opportunity-oriented, and precautionary. According to the first, the pandemic was not regarded as a situation that required additional reflection on ethical issues or changes in research approaches. By contrast, the other two were based on the assumption that the pandemic affected research project ethics. The difference was in the assessment of changes in the area of ethics. The pandemic presented an opportunity and a threat to the ethicality of research, respectively. We discuss the implications of all three approaches for research and education. </jats:p>

title: Czy badać? Co badać? Jak badać? Strategie badawcze w naukach społecznych i humanistycznych w pierwszej fali pandemii COVID-19

abstracts.content:
The aim of this paper is to describe the research strategies carried out by female and male researchers in the
social sciences and humanities during the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic. The empirical research which the article
is based on was conducted in April and May 2020 using an online qualitative survey. As a result of the qualitative content
analysis of our research participants’ statements, we characterized four research strategies: resignation, suspension,
continuation, and research (re)construction. We describe the results of the analyses in relation to the characteristics of
disaster research. We indicate that research in a pandemic is relatable to the slow disaster research perspective more
than to the disaster research perspective.

title: More than just sex, more than just friendship: understandings of sex life of nonheterosexual couples in Poland

abstracts.content: The article demonstrates how the problematic socio-political situation of nonheterosexual communities in Poland and Polish traditionalism significantly impacts how nonheterosexual people develop their sexual stories and perceive their sexual practices. It aims to shift the discussion on sex life, primarily conducted in the Anglo-American context that often focuses on the frequency of sexual contact and heteronormative understanding of sexual practices, into a more critical one, attentive to the socio-political context. The article maps queer narratives on sex life and reconstructs the role of heteronormative and homophobic patterns, prejudices, and stereotypes. It demonstrates how public norms and discourses are mirrored, negotiated, and challenged in queer sexual stories. Finally, it shows how these negotiations deeply influence the positionality of nonheterosexual people in Poland and their sexual choices and practices. The article concludes by sharing future paths for research on queer sexual life inspired by geographies of gender and sexualities. The presented analysis draws on 53 individual in-depth narrative interviews and a monthly ethnographic study conducted with 21 nonheterosexual families done within the Families of Choice in Poland research project.

title: Jakość badań jakościowych podczas pandemii COVID-19 : doświadczenia badaczy i badaczek społeczno-humanistycznych

abstracts.content:
In this article we describe the changes in the quality of qualitative research resulting
from the adaptation of research practices to the pandemic conditions at the successive stages of research process. The analysis is based on 32 in-depth interviews with researchers
in social sciences and humanities. We discuss ‘routes to quality’ and ‘routes to non-quality’
in qualitative research during the pandemic crisis. The researchers were ambivalent about
the impact of the pandemic conditions on the quality of their research. Cluster analysis
showed that the strategies for ensuring the quality of qualitative research differed due to
the attentiveness to quality changes at different phases of the research process. Two main
strategies were distinguished: the pursuit of quality during the phase of research conduct
and the holistic strategies focused on quality assurance in all phases of research. The
results were interpreted in relation to the four approaches to quality in qualitative research,
which can be distinguished on the basis of literature review.

title: Learning ethnic nomenclature in the practice of fieldwork among Romani people in Poland

abstracts.content: Over two decades of interpersonal, anthropological research within Romani communities in Poland, the authors have encountered a variety of linguistic practices reflecting self-definition `and identity. Against that backdrop, this paper focuses on the motives and strategies adopted by Romani leaders in their conscious choices between the denominations of Romowie and Cyganie. The authors intend to answer two questions: (1) Why do specific Romani individuals – Polish citizens – accept (or not) the word Romowie or Cyganie in specific situations; and (2) What significance does this phenomenon have for the relationship between Romani communities and the social majority? In addressing these queries, the authors note a detailed, situational construction of cultural reality – that is, a re-evaluation of the existing meaning as enacted both practically and subjectively. This text illustrates how individuals organize their actions independently, and endow objects with meaning via pre-existing ways of understanding found in the cultural order.

title: Problematyka zobowiązań Republiki Kosowa do przestrzegania międzynarodowych standardów praw człowieka — rozważania na tle specyfiki statusu prawnego  Kosowa, implikacji procesu pojednania oraz aspektów polityki bezpieczeństwa i praw człowieka w regionie Bałkanów Zachodnich

abstracts.content: Kosovo declaró su independencia de Serbia en 2008, pero no todos los Estados la reconocen. En la actualidad, más de 100 países, entre ellos Estados Unidos y la mayoría de los Estados miembros de la Unión Europea, reconocen a Kosovo como Estado independiente. Sin embargo, Serbia no reconoce esta declaración y sigue considerando Kosovo como parte de su territorio. El objetivo de este artículo, por tanto, es intentar responder a las preguntas: ¿cuál es la especificidad del disfrute por los ciudadanos de Kosovo de las normas de derechos humanos reconocidas, y si el proceso de reconciliación y la rendición de cuentas transitoria determinan el grado de protección de los derechos de los ciudadanos? El estatuto jurídico de Kosovo ha pasado de ser una provincia que formaba parte de la república de Serbia dentro de Yugoslavia, luego de Serbia y Montenegro, más tarde de Serbia, a convertirse en un protectorado oficial en virtud de la Resolución 1244 del Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU, de 10 de junio de 1999, sobre la situación en Kosovo, y a declarar su independencia en 2008, pero aún no está plenamente reconocido como Estado por la comunidad internacional. El caso de Kosovo no solo se utiliza con fines políticos y estratégicos, como la anexión de Crimea por parte de la Federación Rusa, ilegal desde el punto de vista del derecho internacional, sino que también funciona como ejemplo de «experimento exitoso» positivo por parte de la ONU en el contexto del apoyo al surgimiento de un Estado independiente y democrático tras un conflicto. Sin embargo, la falta de pleno reconocimiento internacional de esta independencia es indicativa de la falta de una postura unificada sobre el rumbo de Kosovo y su estatus jurídico.

Uzasadnienie:
W artykule autorki analizują proces instytucjonalnego i politycznego kształtowania ochrony praw człowieka w Kosowie w specyficznych uwarunkowaniach państwa postkonfliktowego. Autorki przedstawiają również wielowymiarowe mechanizmy budowy struktur państwowych i wdrażania standardów prawnych oraz politycznych, wskazując na kluczową rolę organów krajowych — takich jak Trybunał Konstytucyjny, Ombudsperson Institution czy kosowska administracja — w zapewnianiu obywatelom podstawowych gwarancji prawnych. Wnikliwie ukazano, w jaki sposób proces pojednania, odpowiedzialność tranzycyjna oraz implementacja polityki praworządności są powiązane z dynamicznym rozwojem instytucji Kosowa i ich adaptacją do norm europejskich, co stanowi trzon refleksji właściwej dla nauk o polityce i administracji. Kontekst stosunków międzynarodowych i oddziaływań zewnętrznych, takich jak rezolucje Rady Bezpieczeństwa ONZ czy działania misji UE, został przedstawiony przede wszystkim jako istotne tło dla analizy wewnętrznych procesów polityczno-administracyjnych. Artykuł przyczynia się do pogłębienia rozumienia mechanizmów budowania porządku instytucjonalnego i zarządzania w młodym państwie, co stanowi istotny wkład w rozwój badań prowadzonych w ramach nauk o polityce i administracji. 


Kosowo ogłosiło niepodległość od Serbii w 2008 r., jednak nie jest uznawane przez wszystkie państwa. Obecnie ponad 100 państw, w tym Stany Zjednoczone Ameryki i większość krajów członkowskich Unii Europejskiej, uznaje Kosowo za niepodległe państwo. Sama Serbia nie uznaje tej deklaracji i nadal uważa Kosowo za część swojego terytorium. Celem niniejszego artykułu jest zatem próba odpowiedzi na pytania: Na czym polega specyfika korzystania przez obywateli Kosowa z uznanych standardów praw człowieka? oraz Czy proces pojednania i odpowiedzialność tranzycyjna determinują zakres ochrony praw obywatelskich? Status prawny Kosowa ewoluował — od prowincji stanowiącej część Republiki Serbii w składzie Jugosławii, następnie Serbii i Czarnogóry, potem Serbii, by na mocy Rezolucji Rady Bezpieczeństwa ONZ nr 1244 z dnia 10 czerwca 1999 r. w sprawie sytuacji związanej z Kosowem stać się formalnie protektoratem podległym tymczasowej administracji Organizacji Narodów Zjednoczonych, a w 2008 r. ogłosić niepodległość. Przy tym wciąż jednak jest to podmiot, który nie jest w pełni uznawany jako państwo przez społeczność międzynarodową. Kazus Kosowa jest wykorzystywany nie tylko do celów politycznych i strategicznych, jak chociażby nielegalna z punktu widzenia prawa międzynarodowego aneksja Krymu przez Federację Rosyjską, ale także funkcjonuje jako przykład pozytywnego, „udanego eksperymentu” ONZ w kontekście wsparcia powstania niepodległego, demokratycznego państwa postkonfliktowego. Częściowe uznanie niepodległości Kosowa na arenie międzynarodowej świadczy o braku jednolitego stanowiska w kwestii kierunku jego rozwoju i statusu prawnego.

Kosovo declared independence from Serbia in 2008, but is not recognised by all states. Today, more than 100 countries, including the United States and most European Union member states, recognise Kosovo as an independent state. However, Serbia does not accept this declaration and still considers Kosovo as part of its territory. The aim of this article, therefore, is to try to answer the questions: what is the specificity of Kosovo citizens' enjoyment of recognised human rights standards, and whether the reconciliation process and transitional accountability determine the extent of civil rights protection. Kosovo's legal status has evolved from being a province that was part of the republic of Serbia within Yugoslavia, then Serbia and Montenegro, then Serbia, to becoming a formal protectorate under the UN Interim Administration pursuant to the UN Security Council Resolution 1244 of 10 June 1999 on the situation regarding Kosovo, and finally declaring independence in 2008. However, it is still an entity that is not fully recognised as a state by the international community. The case of Kosovo is not only used for political and strategic purposes, such as the annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation, which is illegal from the point of view of international law, but it also functions as an example of a positive, ‘successful experiment’ by the UN in the context of supporting the emergence of an independent, democratic post-conflict state. However, the lack of full international recognition of this independence is indicative of the lack of a unified position on the development direction of Kosovo and its legal status.
